## Content references

- [NumOps product](https://www.aiwin.com.tw/products/numops): data preparation, AutoML, expert systems, classification, regression, anomaly detection, time series, clustering, evaluation and deployment. Official screen numbers are demonstrations, not performance promises.
- [AIWin / WinHub introduction, 2022-08-25](https://aiwin.com.tw/archives/15746): GSD and AIWin jointly developed WaterOps by combining water-domain knowledge and AI implementation; NumOps offers AutoML and expert systems.
- [WaterOps platform introduction](https://www.waterops.net/plateformIntro): no-code learning, water data analysis, expert knowledge, model training and deployment.
- [WaterOps home](https://www.waterops.net/): water-quality data input, algorithm selection, simulation and expert knowledge.
- [AIWin / WaterOps AI Switch cooperation, 2025-11-26](https://aiwin.com.tw/archives/16545): WaterOps with WinEdge-N; AI-supported water treatment and dosing.
- [WaterOps / GSD precision dosing case, 2026-06-05](https://www.waterops.net/news/page/%E6%9C%80%E6%96%B0%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF/88): GSD assisted SPIL's Central Taiwan Science Park plant with a boron-wastewater precision dosing system integrating WaterOps and AI inference. Published chemical-use reductions: **BaCl₂ 45%, H₂O₂ 24%**. These are specific to this installation, not total operating cost or a universal platform result. The award collage is stored unmodified and the right-hand award photograph is framed using CSS.
- [Taiwan Ministry of Environment award announcement, 2026-06-05](https://enews.moenv.gov.tw/moenv-news/zh-tw/News/1619): independently confirms SPIL's 2026 award and smart dosing case. The award recipient is **SPIL**, not GSD or AIWin. The exact category on the WaterOps article is 水處理卓越獎 / 智慧低碳管理組（高科技產業組）.
- The bottom WaterOps workflow is a platform-level illustration. It is not a live control view or a specification of the SPIL installation. The page deliberately does not attribute an unverified WinEdge-N hardware configuration to that plant.
- `../pitch-oven-temperature.png` comes from the user's existing Pitch v5, p.34. The 27 dampers / 15 temperature points are from that existing case.

## Authored visuals

Signal sculpture, diagrams, model-training animation, water workflow, hardware illustration and fusion blocks are original HTML/CSS/SVG illustrations. They are conceptual, not a live model run, a physical equipment specification, or a customer measurement. No automatic retraining, guaranteed savings or accuracy claims are added.

The WaterOps partnership and “data AutoML platform” framing follow the user's product description together with the public references. WaterOps is not represented as a renamed NumOps product or a solely owned AIWin brand.
